# AI.SKILLS

> Drop-in components for AI coding agents (Claude Code) and the developer's environment: plugins, skills and a font. Source: https://github.com/microbians/AI.SKILLS

## Pages

- [CodeIndex](https://microbians.github.io/AI.SKILLS/plugins/code-index/index.md): Claude's index to your codebase — every class, function and method with file:line, signature and doc, so Claude finds code without searching it.
- [The Secretary](https://microbians.github.io/AI.SKILLS/plugins/secretary/index.md): local memory for Claude Code — conversations kept verbatim, handoffs between sessions, recall by words and meaning.
- [Meslo Code](https://microbians.github.io/AI.SKILLS/fonts/index.md): a monospaced font for code with Menlo's line spacing, Fira Code ligatures and Nerd Fonts icons.

## Optional

- [Repository README](https://microbians.github.io/AI.SKILLS/README.md): every plugin and skill in the collection.
